title: NexusLink Art Production Index
note: Enemy nameZh/nameEn/emotion/emotionLabelZh/flavor are generated verbatim from src/data/enemyRegistry.js — do not hand-edit; regenerate if the registry changes.
howToUse: Iterate batches[] where status == 'ready'. Generate every item in items[].

Write each PNG to item.output.stagingPath (Codex workspace under output/). DO NOT write into assets/** directly: assets/** is GROUNDWORK and promotion is a separate Owner-approved step (item.output.targetAssetPath is the eventual destination).
Match item.output exactly: 512x512, frameCount 1, transparent RGBA PNG; no baked background/UI/text/frame-border.
Colour: tint each figure to its emotion via batches[].emotionTints[emotion]; HSL hue+sat are the source of truth (runtime RIFT_EMOTION_TINT), hex is a convenience.

After generation, record a per-item QC note (dimensions, transparent corners, emotion colour) as the five-companion pilots did; Owner comparative approval + a GROUNDWORK asset-readiness task gate any assets/** promotion.
Do not generate batches with status != 'ready' — they are blocked on engineering wiring and/or an Owner scope decision (see batch.blockedOn).

globalSpec.cleanFrameRule: no baked white/background, no UI, no text, no display stand, no codex frame; clean subject only with transparent margins

batches.title: Rift enemy silhouettes
batches.reviewStatus: review-approved candidate: Owner approved both pilots in chat and authorized batch completion without per-image gates; per-item QC in output/rift-silhouettes/BATCH_QC.md
batches.designRef: CHAPTER_RESONANCE_ROADMAP_V2 §7 (v2): replace the procedural mist core with 10 x 512 rift silhouettes
batches.deliverablePerItem: ONE static 512x512 transparent PNG per enemy (frameCount 1). Motion stays code-driven: the runtime keeps the existing phase/intent-driven breathing (scale/opacity), so no animation frames are needed.
batches.wiringStatus: DONE (runtime-promoted): finals copied to assets/enemies/{enemyId}/, mapped via ASSET_MANIFEST.enemies (src/data/assetManifest.js), drawn by battleController rf-sprite layer keyed by enemyId; procedural mist retained as loading/failure fallback; release gate asset_integrity now cross-checks enemyRegistry vs manifest vs 512x512 PNGs. See AI_EXECUTION_LEDGER Lane 1, 2026-07-12.
styleRules: Abstract emotion-mist / silhouette, NOT a creature: no face, no eyes, no mouth, no clear animal anatomy. It is emotional pollution leaking from a rift, not a monster.
Three-layer read (matches the procedural figure it replaces): soft outer mist halo / denser inner core / thin noise-vein filaments.
Cyber-Taoism aesthetic: ethereal, semi-transparent, faint glow; must read against both the day and night lake sky — keep a darker inner core so it does not vanish on a bright sky.
Subject centered in the 512 frame with transparent margins; the runtime positions/anchors it.
Each figure's overall SHAPE follows item.shapeHint (derived from its flavor) so the ten read as distinct, while all remain faceless emotion-mist.
negativePrompts: no baked drop shadow on a ground plane

items.flavor: 一縷從裂隙飄散出來的雜訊，碰到情緒就會嗡嗡作響。
items.shapeHint: 一縷飄散雜訊，嗡嗡震顫的細絲狀霧體，邊緣細碎。

items.flavor: 一層薄薄的淚光懸在裂隙口，輕輕一碰就會化開。
items.shapeHint: 最輕最透的一層懸垂淚光幕，將化未化。

items.flavor: 由遺跡碎晶聚成的小魔像，動作慢，但每一步都很沉。
items.shapeHint: 碎晶聚成的沉重稜角塊體，緩慢下壓感（抽象、無臉）。

items.flavor: 一點按不下去的火星，動不動就往外炸。
items.shapeHint: 一點按不住的火星，邊緣往外炸的尖刺感。

items.flavor: 貼著裂隙邊緣游動的影子，會試圖模仿你夥伴的輪廓。
items.shapeHint: 游動的影子，邊緣模糊擬態、似像又不像夥伴輪廓。

items.flavor: 越纏越緊的影子，總在你以為沒事時又繃起來。
items.shapeHint: 越纏越緊的螺旋影，緊繃盤繞。

items.flavor: 一具被情緒掏空後留下的殼，沉沉地散著「好累」的低頻。
items.shapeHint: 被掏空的殼，中空、下垂、低頻沉重。

items.flavor: 沉得幾乎不想動的殘殼，散著「好重、好想睡」的低頻。
items.shapeHint: 幾乎不動的沉墜塊，最重、往下拖。

items.flavor: 在裂隙裡反覆迴盪的空響，像有人對著無人的夜一直喊。
items.shapeHint: 空心的回響環，一圈圈向外淡開。

items.flavor: 在空曠裡反覆飄盪的回音，像對著沒人的夜輕輕問「還在嗎」。
items.shapeHint: 空曠中飄盪的回音環，鬆散、飄移。
